## See the UI

- `./gradlew :cmp-desktop:run` — Desktop window — fastest way to actually look at the shared UI
- `./gradlew :cmp-web:wasmJsBrowserDevelopmentRun` — Browser — shared UI in a dev server
- `xcodebuild -project cmp-ios/iosApp.xcodeproj -scheme <scheme> -destination "id=$(xcrun simctl list devices available -j | jq -r '..|objects|select(.name?=="iPhone 17")|.udid' | head -1)" build` — iOS simulator — drive by UDID, never by name

- **detekt** — static analysis

- **Compose Hot Reload** — live UI edit on JVM/desktop
- **Compose Multiplatform** — shared UI
- **Koin** — DI
